includeClipEndpoints.description: Applies only to scope=shot: additionally identify whole-clip start/end using the first/last shot boundary images. False does not cancel the start/end strategy for scope=clip.

maxMiddleFrames.description: Preferred reference quantity for non-endpoint images, per clip or per shot. The submitted user value is frozen as model guidance only. Zero is valid and does not prohibit intermediate frames. Actual returned frames are retained and receive prompt tasks without exact-count matching, padding, trimming or a quantity-based pause.

referenceImages.description: Ordered explicit image selection. Omitted or empty means no images; never collect defaults during submission.

committedAtMs.description: Durable commit receipt timestamp in Unix milliseconds; null before commit.

snapshot.description: Explicitly request a new history snapshot even when the canonical body is unchanged. Omitted or false preserves ordinary save no-op behavior. Snapshot-only saves do not change the body, its updated time or body revision; historyVersionId identifies the committed snapshot.
